title: Reduce full state snapshot cost and frequency for very large session collections
outcome: DEV profiling observed full SSE state frames for 2,313 sessions taking 65-154ms on the main thread (JSON.parse 27-97ms, adoption 33-50ms). This is not a CPU-triggered refresh; it is backend-pushed state. Investigate which mutations still publish full snapshots instead of deltas and whether the wire projection/parser can avoid repeated large JSON work without weakening recovery semantics.
